description: Search Chewy.com for pet products, browse by category or brand, or enrich specific product URLs.

autoshipOnly.description: Only return products eligible for Chewy Autoship subscription.
autoshipOnly.title: Autoship eligible only

brandName.description: Brand name to scrape all products for (mode=byBrand). Example: `Royal Canin`, `Blue Buffalo`.
brandName.title: Brand name (mode=byBrand)

categoryUrl.description: Full Chewy category URL to browse (mode=byCategory). Example: `https://www.chewy.com/b/dry-food-294`.
categoryUrl.title: Category URL (mode=byCategory)

inStockOnly.description: Only return products currently in stock.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Only return products priced at or below this value.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price ($)

minPrice.description: Only return products priced at or above this value.
minPrice.title: Minimum price ($)

minRating.description: Only return products with an average rating at or above this value (0.0–5.0).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: How to find products. `search` for keyword search, `byCategory` to browse a category URL, `byBrand` for all products of a brand, `byProductUrls` to enrich specific product pages.
mode.title: Mode

petType.description: Filter search results by pet type (mode=search).
petType.title: Pet type filter

searchQuery.description: Keyword search query (mode=search). Example: `dog food`, `cat toys`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort order for search and category results.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: List of Chewy product page URLs to enrich (mode=byProductUrls). Example: `https://www.chewy.com/royal-canin-adult-dry-dog-food/dp/123456`.
startUrls.title: Product URLs (mode=byProductUrls)

title: Chewy Product Scraper Input
